items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: I had to say well you know we’ve got to — so the point is they had me at their Christmas party before they lost all their money.

ctx.x: Well we did a tour, and Valerie Simpson came out with us as our special guest. Truthfully I never had to tour as opposed to pretty much all my friends. You know I started doing theater and then studio work and television and I find that traveling is just — it doesn’t agree with me. The guys say, “I love the bus.” “Are you crazy?” “No I’d much rather get back on that bus than sleep in a bed.” You know going like that. And then the next morning at 6 AM the sun and you come out of the bus with your costume over your…

I’m going to close with two quotes, this first one is from Eugene Levy a/k/a Johnny Rose from the dream sequence in Schitt’s Creek after you finish the swing version of “Silent Night” and Johnny Rose referring to you said, “He’s worth every penny.”

Well that was in their prop — their plot of course, showing that they were so wealthy that they could afford the great Paul Shaffer if you will, for their party. It was a Christmas party. But God bless them I had to say well you know we’ve got to — so the point is they had me at their Christmas party before they lost all their money. I said, “But you’ve got to at least tell people who I am.” “Oh no it’ll just be great that you’re there.” Well you’ve got a lot more confidence in my stature. Tell the people who I…
